sourcePageTitle: Spider-Man 2099 Reading Order - Comic Book Herald
sourceBoundary: All 23 Collects blocks and the explicit Fall of the Hammer sequence on the full Spider-Man 2099 guide, from the original 1992 run through all four Latest Additions blocks ending with Miguel O'Hara - Spider-Man: 2099 (2024) #5. Collection order is retained; later repeated issue references point backward to the first occurrence. Named annuals, original one-shots and material-from issues retain original identities. Linked guides are not expanded; no source commentary or artwork is copied.
sourceTextNormalization: Issue-bearing factual blocks only. Typography is normalized to ASCII apostrophes and hyphens; source issue references expand collection ranges and use verified publication spelling/year. No article prose or image bytes are retained.

identityNotes.timestormSpider: The source Spider-Man One-Shot under Timestorm is the separately indexed Timestorm 2009/2099: Spider-Man (2009) #1.
identityNotes.timestormXmen: The source X-Men One-Shot under Timestorm is the separately indexed Timestorm 2009/2099: X-Men (2009) #1.
identityNotes.return: Out of Time and Spider-Verse use the 2014 Spider-Man 2099 run.
identityNotes.amazing: Amazing Spider-Man #1 alongside Out of Time is the 2014 run, not the 2018 Latest Additions run.
identityNotes.future: Smack to the Future through Back to Future Shock use the separate 2015 Spider-Man 2099 run.
identityNotes.alpha: Exodus Alpha is a named original one-shot with its own verified series, not issue 1 of Exodus.
identityNotes.omega: Exodus Omega is a named original one-shot with its own verified series, not issue 5 of Exodus.

metadataHydration.policy: Reuse exact pinned records with hashes and explicit field adaptation; fetch only missing originals. Optional metadata is not invented and availability hints do not prove access.
